The files here are copies, unmodified, of the ATIP contract at tag v1.1.0 (commit da69df042b1140915d6a5e674b306bf7b5cfd187): `examples/schema-command-*.json`, `examples/schema-tree*.json` and `examples/schema-group.json` at the top, and in `invalid/` the files of `examples/invalid/` that break one rule of spec 10.13 (rules 1-7, 9-11, 13). Used by the unit tests of `src/l1/rules.rs` and `src/l1/project.rs`; the table of which rule each invalid file breaks is in those tests.
